name: Bethuel
bio: Bethuel is the son of Nahor and Milcah, father of Rebekah and Laban (Genesis 22:22-23; 24:15). When Abraham's servant came seeking Rebekah as a wife for Isaac, Bethuel joined his son Laban in giving their consent, saying, "The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good" (Genesis 24:50). Scripture makes no further mention of Bethuel after this; his daughter Rebekah would go on to become an important matriarch of the nation of Israel.
